text: これ　あげるから　きみも　つり　まくりなさいよ！

structure.jp: きみも　つり　まくりなさいよ！
structure.en: you go and fish like crazy too!

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a verb gives the reason for what comes next: 'so'. あげるから = 'I'll give it to you, so'.

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.span: つり　まくりなさい
patterns.explanation: まくる after an action means doing it like crazy, over and over. つりまくりなさい = 'fish like crazy'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: なさい on a verb stem is a firm order, like an adult telling a child what to do. まくりなさい = 'go and do it like crazy'.
